checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Building recognizable as Biltmore House, pale stone French Renaissance, steep slate roof
must.why: A pale-stone château with steep slate roofs and a turret, period carriages. But the composition is a generic château and the long Biltmore facade and stair tower are not clearly right. Partly met at best.

must.item: Location and date appear exactly and readable
must.why: The caption text is garbled gibberish. The location and date are not readable.
The label is garbled ('reono broofofuin'), so it is not legible.

must.item: No modern cars, clothing, string lights or signage
must.why: Only horse-drawn carriages and lamplight are visible, with no modern items.

must.item: English narration identifies opening to family and friends
must.why: Clip 01 is silent. Clip 02 has sound, but the frames are black and the speech was not heard. The assistant's message claims the line, but I can't verify it.

faults.what: All four on-screen texts are garbled nonsense in a caption band under the picture. This is the core requirement.
The second clip is entirely black for the whole 8 s, with audio only. It is a useless extra deliverable and confusing.
The first clip has no audio, so the promised narration is missing from the visible deliverable.
The caption band is a large pale strip that crops the frame. The 'small label' is not small.
The building looks like a generic château and the carriages are mushy, with some AI artefacts.

summary: The clip shows an atmospheric dusk château with horse carriages, but all the required text is garbled, one output is silent and the other is entirely black with audio only.
